summary: Added helper scripts for preparing and building from a local workspace seeded from the ArcRho ZIP archive.
details: The batch wrapper copies E:\XWSpace\Repos\ArcRho.zip to the local user profile Documents\build_arcrho_app folder, extracts it, and runs the build from there.
Set ARCRHO_LOCAL_BUILD_ROOT to choose a different local build workspace.
Set ARCRHO_LOCAL_BUILD_SOURCE_ZIP to choose a different source ZIP.
The existing local build workspace is always deleted before the ZIP is extracted.
ZIP extraction supports standard forward-slash directory entries and skips repository metadata that can exceed Windows PowerShell 5.1 path limits.
The batch wrapper warns when the source ZIP timestamp has not changed since the previous successful ZIP-based local build.
